purpose: Teach: チャイナ/ウエスト/浦和/三島/ジェフ/クラーク/コロンビア/セントラル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、チャイナドレスのコレクターだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer collects cheongsams, doesn't he?
lines.style: Gentle, almost wondering aloud. Soft cadence, as if sharing an observation just occurred to her. Warm nostalgia in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ウエスト引き締めのジムに通われてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer goes to the gym to keep his waist trim, doesn't he?
lines.style: Thoughtful murmur. Slight amusement underneath — noticing something endearing about his care. Slow, reflective pacing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、浦和レッズの試合観に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer goes to watch the Urawa Reds play, doesn't he?
lines.style: Soft recognition in the voice. A smile without urgency. Pace relaxed, like she's remembering details fondly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、三島由紀夫の小説がご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer enjoys reading Yukio Mishima novels, doesn't he?
lines.style: Quiet admiration. Thoughtful tempo. The slight breathiness of someone impressed by a detail she finds meaningful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ジェフユナイテッドのファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer is a fan of JEF United, isn't he?
lines.style: Gentle affirmation. Slight lilt at the end — sharing something she's pieced together. Warm, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、クラーク博士の信念を尊敬されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer admires Dr. Clark's beliefs, doesn't he?
lines.style: Reverent softness. She's found something she respects about him. Measured pace, quiet conviction in the tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コロンビアのコーヒー豆を取り寄せてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer has Colombian coffee beans shipped to him, doesn't he?
lines.style: Delighted discovery in the voice. Small wonder at the specificity of his taste. Slightly warmer energy than before.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、セントラルパークでのジョギングが日課だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer jogs in Central Park every day, doesn't he?
lines.style: Fond observation delivered softly. A trailing warmth at the end, like she's seeing him more clearly now. Gentle fadeout.
